Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard (Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

RECOMMENDED PARAMETERS OF 

WASTE HEAT BOILERS AND BOILERS FOR 

SPECIAL PURPOSES 



1. Seep® — Covers the recommended parameters for waste heat boilers and boilers for special 
purposes. Recommended parameters for general stationary steam boilers are covered in a 
separate standard IS : 8596-1977 ' Recommended parameters of stationary steam boilers \ 

2. Terminology — The definitions given in IS : 9330-1979 • Terminology for parameters of waste 
heat boilers and boilers for special purposes- are applicable. 

3 S Recommended Parameters 

3.1 Maximum Continuous Rating (MCR) —The maximum continuous rating of waste heat boilers 
depends upon the gas side parameters. So it is not practicable to fix up recommended values. 

3.2 Specified Pressure of hAain Steam — The recommended values of specified pressure of main 
steam ( gauge ) in mega pascals ( MPa ) shall be as given below: 

1,1-6,2-0.2-5,3-2,4-0,5-0 
3.2*1 Where the steam is used for process, it is not possible to recommend the values. 

3.3 Specified Temperature of Main Steam — The recommended values of specified temperature of 
main steam in °C shall be as given below: 

200, 250, 315, 400 
Note — For saturated steam the saturation temperature shall apply. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The quantities in this standard have been expressed in International System (SI) of units. 
However, for the sake of convenience the relative metric units and the corresponding conversion 
factors are given below for general guidance: 

1 kgf/cm* = 98-066 5 kPa ( kilo pascal ) = 0'098 066 5 MPa ( mega pascal ) 

= 0'980 66 5 bar 
1 MPa =° 10-196 1 kgf/cm 2 

Unlike in other boilers, in the waste heat boilers the steam side parameters are not the 
limiting ones because the steam parameters are decided by the gas side parameters, which in turn 
are fixed by the process requirement of the industries in which these boilers are being used. It is 
not possible to give recommended values of maximum continuous rating for these boilers. Also, 
most of these boilers produce saturated steam. Therefore, the specified temperatures of the main 
steam are fixed by the specified pressures of the steam. The specified pressure of the steam to be 
produced also cannot be recommended as it is being fixed by the customers based on their process 
requirements.
